title: Uwashinzwe gukurikira
intro: Umuntu wo mu bihe vya kera ahagaze yiteguriye gutera intambwe muri kahise. Igihe inzira yasa n’iyidatomoye kandi amakenga akwiragira mu bantu, uwo musuku yaratowe ngo afate igitambaro co kuyobora. Bafise uburemere bw’ubutumwa bweranda ku bitugu vyabo, baratera intambwe kugira ngo bayobore aho abandi bakekeranya gukurikira.
clues: Natowe kujana n'umuhanuzi kandi nigira ku bwenge bwabo .
Nahagaze imbere y’Isandugu igihe umuhango w’Umufasha wacu wari wegereje, maze mbona abantu batangura gukekeranya .
Naciye mpagarara ku ruhande rw’ivyo vyasezeranywe mu gihe umurongozi wacu yariko arababara kandi atakambira Allah ku bwacu .
Nashinzwe kubandanya ubutumwa nari nahawe uwundi imbere yanje .
Narahawe ububasha buva ku Mana bwo kuyobora abantu iyo bariko baraja .
Narashoboye kurangiza ivyo vyari vyatanguye imbere yanje, kandi nararonse ivyemezo vy’abantu vy’ubuyobozi bwanje .

arabic: يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْأَرْضَ ٱلْمُقَدَّسَةَ ٱلَّتِى كَتَبَ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ وَلَا تَرْتَدُّوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَدْبَارِكُمْ فَتَنقَلِبُوا۟ خَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: O my people, enter the blessed land [i.e., Palestine] which Allāh has assigned to you and do not turn back [from fighting in Allāh's cause] and [thus] become losers." (5:21)
